Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full documents-checklist payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Documents you'll need","subtitle":"For your building permit application","documents":[{"id":"id","name":"Government-issued ID","detail":"Driver's license or passport","status":"received"},{"id":"proof","name":"Proof of residency","detail":"Utility bill within 60 days","status":"required"},{"id":"site","name":"Site plan","detail":"PDF, drawn to scale","status":"required"},{"id":"insurance","name":"Contractor insurance","detail":"Only if using a contractor","status":"optional"}],"submitText":"Upload selected","submitValue":"I'd like to upload the selected documents"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading; defaults to "Documents you'll need".
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title (e.g. what the documents are for).
- 'documents' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the documents for this application/enrollment. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection) and 'name' (string). Optional per document: 'detail' (string, one short line, e.g. an accepted format or condition); 'status' (string; one of 'required','received','optional' — drives the status pill: required=navy, received=green, optional=muted; defaults to 'required'). A document with status 'received' is shown checked and is NOT selectable (it has already been provided). 'required' and 'optional' documents are multi-selectable.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Upload selected'. The button shows the count of selected documents.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the selected document names when sending back.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
